description.value: Umi Sushi Express is a quick-service Japanese cuisine franchise operating over 30 locations across Canada, offering fresh sushi and related dishes for customers on the go. The Burnaby outlet on Kingsway is a takeout-only counter with no on-site seating, making it a grab-and-go stop for cyclists passing through the corridor. It is one of three banner formats in the Umi family, focused on fresh, healthy Japanese food made with care.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands at 40m; stands at 46m; stands at 65m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies a takeout-only sushi fast food location at 4700 Kingsway, Burnaby, with takeaway=only, indoor_seating=no, and outdoor_seating=no. The website is a corporate franchise site showing a different headquarters address (Richmond) and corporate phone number, with no location-specific page content rendered for the Burnaby outlet; the locations subpage loaded without any listing detail. No evidence exists on either the website or in OSM tags to confirm bike parking, water refill, or washroom availability.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-568-9228 (location-specific), but the website shows the corporate number (604) 207-8871.
Address mismatch: OSM lists 4700 Kingsway, Burnaby; the website only displays the corporate headquarters address at 1003-2560 Shell Road, Richmond — no location-specific address is confirmed.
The /locations.html subpage loaded without rendering any individual location listings, so the Burnaby outlet cannot be cross-checked against the franchise's own site.
Takeout-only with no seating and no washroom information; this limits the utility of the listing for WWC accreditation without further on-the-ground verification.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a functioning takeout-only food stop on a busy cycling corridor, which could be useful to touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence, and the corporate website provides no location-specific detail.
enrichment_extras.notes: On-site verification recommended to confirm bike parking options, water refill availability, and proximity to public washrooms before including in the directory.
